links.outcome: Appropriateness, harm, and omissions of LLM diagnostic vs therapeutic recommendations in pediatric critical care
links.effect: Diagnostic recommendations appropriate 94% (ED) and 98% (PICU); therapeutic only 82%. Potentially harmful therapeutic suggestions 7% vs 2% (ED) and 10% vs 0% (PICU); 0.95 critically missing therapeutic recommendations per PICU case.
links.quote: Potentially harmful therapeutic suggestions were more common than diagnostic ones: 7% vs. 2% in the ED (p = 0.016) and 10% vs. 0% in the PICU (p < 0.00001).

links.outcome: LLM performance on real-world clinical cases across diagnosis, triage, and therapy tasks
links.effect: Correct diagnosis in 100% of ED discharge and 95% of PICU 24-h differentials; triage accurate in all PICU cases; therapeutic recommendations appropriate in only 82%.
links.quote: Triage decisions were accurate in all PICU cases.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of ChatGPT-4.0 on real-world pediatric ICU and emergency cases assessing diagnostic and therapeutic recommendations for accuracy, omissions, and safety, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
